text:
Anselm Reyes has been named the new conductor of the Halewyn Philharmonic, effective 1 September, the orchestra said Tuesday. He succeeds Mara Venn, who steps down after a six-season run that lifted subscription renewals to 84%, up from 71% in 2020.

Reyes, 43, joins from the Bracken Hall Orchestra, where ticket revenue rose 12% under his tenure. Halewyn said it has already sold 61% of its 2026 season packages, helped by a revised program centered on shorter, higher-turnover concerts and two touring dates.

The appointment matters beyond one orchestra: regional ensembles are leaning on star hires and leaner schedules to protect margins as donor growth slows and venue costs keep climbing.
